description:
Position Summary

Virtuous is looking for a data-driven, hands-on sales development leader with experience in SaaS, nonprofit technology, and/or fundraising to join our growing Sales Development team.

As the co-SDR Manager, you'll lead and scale our team of SDRs and run our outbound and inbound pipeline function like a system. The primary focus of the role is coaching a team that creates qualified pipeline across multiple products, while acting as a pseudo GTM engineer: you'll help guide the build of workflows, automation, and data that let every rep do more with less manual effort alongside our operations team.

You'll live in the space between Marketing and Sales to ensure every effort is taken to maximize qualified meetings and no lead is left behind. You'll write and test sequence copy, run A/B tests on a steady rhythm, and let the numbers tell you what to improve next.

Your top priorities: (1) solution (multiproduct) selling, so each account hears the right offer for its needs; (2) account-based selling, with coordinated, researched outreach to target accounts; (3) identifying gaps in current sales outreach and solutioning against it; and (4) creating lift with AI and process. SDR is a numbers game, so volume and conversion both matter. Your job is to help raise output per rep and make the team measurably more efficient.

You'll report to the VP of Revenue Marketing and work with Marketing, Sales, and Ops on three primary focus areas: team management and coaching, multiproduct pipeline generation, and operational efficiency. You'll work alongside another SDR Manager, and the two of you will share leadership of both the outbound and inbound motions, splitting the team and the work between you.

What You'll Own

Sales Development

  • Coach and lead a team of SDRs to generate Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) for Virtuous across every product.

  • Individually contribute: write sequence copy, launch outbound campaigns, and test and optimize strategies. We want someone who leads by example and isn't afraid to "do" with the team.

  • Run account-based selling: pick target accounts with Sales and Marketing, research them, and coordinate multi-threaded outreach across personas so one account gets one researched, well-timed motion. Match the right product to the right persona, segment, and trigger.

  • Identify gaps in the current sales process. Coach reps to ask the right discovery questions, connect gaps to the right Virtuous product, and hand AEs context on the problem and the proposed fit.

  • Sell the full portfolio: spot cross-sell and multiproduct opportunities early and build plays that open conversations beyond a single product.

  • Manage routing and handoff rules between SDRs, AEs, and cross-sell owners so one account gets one coordinated motion.

  • Partner with Marketing and the community team to turn partner webinars, events, and content into outbound plays.

  • Learn the nonprofit fundraising space and become an expert on the software needs and pain points behind each product.

  • Set quarterly demand and pipeline targets with GTM leaders, and present weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline metrics by product, segment, and source.

Operational Efficiency and GTM Engineering

  • Build and run prospecting workflows yourself: enrichment, signal-based triggers, lead scoring, routing, and sequence logic in HubSpot and Salesloft (confirm tools).

  • Use AI and automation to cut manual work on research, list building, personalization, and CRM updates, and teach reps to use them.

  • Treat SDR as a numbers game and a lift game: keep volume and conversion rates healthy, then use AI and process changes to raise meetings per rep without adding headcount. Baseline each step, test one change at a time, and measure the lift.

  • Create and manage sequences and messaging so every call, email, and touchpoint is curated, varied, and current.

  • A/B test subject lines, messaging, cadence, and offers consistently, read the results, and ship the winners.

  • Instrument the funnel end to end: find the bottleneck, test a fix, and roll out what works.

  • Own weekly reporting on activity, SALs, conversion, meetings, cost per meeting, and meetings per rep.

  • Keep data clean so leads aren't missed, fields are complete, and reporting is accurate.

  • Maintain a living SDR playbook of templates, snippets, sequences, and tested workflows.

Team Management

  • Coach SDRs on working leads, creating opportunities, and running campaigns, with call and email reviews and weekly review of individual and team progress.

  • Manage activities for meeting and pipeline creation, not raw activity volume.

  • Own the quality of discovery calls and email language: build question frameworks and messaging standards, review calls and emails weekly, and coach reps on what to ask, how to listen, and how to write.

  • Hire, onboard, and shorten ramp time for new SDRs, including professional development and future opportunity mapping into AE, marketing, or ops roles.

  • Drive performance management, holding individuals accountable when benchmarks are not met.

  • Engage your team with regular huddles, interactive meetings, and fun challenges.

  • Partner with the other SDR Manager to split inbound and outbound coverage, share playbooks and learnings, and keep coaching standards and handoffs consistent across the team.

You Must Have

  • 3+ years working in SaaS and/or with nonprofits.

  • 3+ years in sales development, partnerships, or a similar field.

  • 2+ years managing a team or training SDRs to produce meetings and opportunities.

  • Experience building and optimizing in a CRM (especially HubSpot) and sales engagement tools: sequences, routing, scoring, enrichment, and reporting you've configured yourself.

  • You care about email language: strong sequence copywriting, with short, specific, human outreach that earns replies, and an eye for the word choices that make a difference.

  • You care about the discovery call: you know which questions uncover real gaps, and you can coach reps to ask them well and listen closely to the answers.

  • A habit of consistent A/B testing and a restless drive to improve. You're never done tuning a sequence, workflow, or process.

  • Motivation by data and numbers. You let metrics set priorities and turn them into clear recommendations.

  • Experience generating pipeline for more than one product or buyer persona.

Nice to have: experience with AI agents for prospecting and research, and a background in nonprofit fundraising or technology.

You'll Be Successful If

You get things done. At Virtuous, we're doers. We don't invest time in over-planning or building decks. You follow through on every request, keep your cool under pressure, and ship the automation rather than just scope it.

You're generous and a true partner. You listen first, communicate clearly in speech and writing, and keep everyone in the know. You work well with Marketing, Sales, and Ops and look for common ground among stakeholders.

You're agile and a problem solver. You know there are many solutions to the same problem, learn from what fails, and find new ways to streamline processes and raise efficiency.

You're data and numbers motivated. You test constantly, trust the results over opinions, and are always looking for the next improvement.

You're embarrassingly organized. You live by to-dos and timelines, juggle multiple projects at once, and turn any meeting or email thread into action items.

You have a team ethos. You thrive in a creative, fast-paced startup environment and enjoy working cross-functionally. People enjoy working with you because they can trust you.

About Us

Virtuous software is powering the world’s leading nonprofits and inspiring a new generation of generosity.

At Virtuous, we believe generosity has the power to transform the world - and so we are on a mission to create $10B in net new generosity by helping nonprofits better connect with and inspire their donors.

Our talented team is hungry, humble, and committed to delivering best-in-class software solutions, customer success interactions, and sales experiences to the nonprofit community.

Our values are more than just a poster on the wall. Instead, our mission and values are precisely why candidates choose Virtuous. Our core values are:

  1. Build Better: We build audacious ideas to accelerate philanthropy and dismantle the status quo.

  2. Display Radical Generosity: We are generous with our time & talent as we serve our team and the nonprofit community.

  3. Stay Humble & Enjoy the Journey: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

Virtuous should act as a career accelerator for everyone on our team. Team members should look back at their time at Virtuous as one of the most productive and stretching seasons in their professional lives. This means that working at Virtuous isn't for everybody. It is for the select few who are ready to do hard things and build something truly great.

If this sounds like you, we’d love for you to apply!

What We Offer

  • Market competitive pay leveraging Carta data

  • Employee recognition through Bonusly (birthdays, anniversaries, achievements, etc.)

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching- 50% match up to 6% of compensation after 90 days

  • We value our employee’s work-life balance and encourage taking advantage of Unlimited PTO

  • Supportive time off including paid volunteer days and company holidays

  • Employer-contributed healthcare benefits, encompassing medical, dental, and vision coverage, with plans available for dependents and choices for Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).

  • 12 weeks primary parent leave, 4 weeks secondary parent leave - full pay (adoption as well)

  • We pride ourselves on Community and host exciting company outings and events.

We’ve recently noticed an increase in recruitment scams where individuals are impersonating recruiters to obtain personal or financial information through fraudulent interviews and job offers.

Please note that all legitimate communication from Virtuous will only come from the @virtuous.org domain. If you receive a message from other domains, even if they look similar (e.g., virtuouscareers.org or virtuousjobs.com), they are not legitimate and we recommend disregarding it immediately.
